parent_leaf_map_encoding: JSON.stringify(array sorted by ascending path using JavaScript string comparison) plus LF; array objects have keys path,mode,type,sha in that order
source_tree_review: This specifies the exact expected overlay. The producer will accept its new unreferenced tree only after a full recursive readback matches every inherited and added leaf. The resulting tree/commit identity and actual readback verdict are sent in the producer handoff.
